page.layout: One page of text, centred: a woodcut ornament at the top (not transcribed), then the dedication title block with the dedicatee's name and style, the italic "Domino suo clementissimo", a centred italic dedication sentence, and the author's name at the foot. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Faint show-through lines appear in the lower half and are left out.

main_text.head: Illustri & generosissimo co-miti ac domino, Dn. ANTONIO GUNTHERO, Comiti in Oldenburg & Delmenhorst, dynastæ in Je-ver & Kniphau-sen, &c. Domino suo clementissimo.

p.i: hanc de duratione ecclesiæ du-quisitionem humilimé inscribit ac offert.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament at the top is not text and is not transcribed. The faint lines in the lower half of the scan are show-through from the other side and are omitted. The dedication sentence is set across three lines; "du-quisitionem" is read as printed, the first syllable of the word after "ecclesiæ" being unclear, so it is doubtful and should be checked against the original. The accent on "humilimé" is read as printed and may be a grave accent.
